bent.note: pressure-driven (fixed-density in/outlet planes) around a 90deg bend, compared to the formula AT THE SAME matched v_mean/Re (no extrapolation). The excess over the formula is the bend/expansion loss a straight-pipe-per-bin sum structurally cannot represent.
